/*
  Seam between Angular Material (M3 system tokens) and Tailwind: --mat-sys-* -> Tailwind theme namespaces.
  Colors keep M3 role names (--mat-sys-on-primary -> text-on-primary); scales use Tailwind sizes (large -> lg, extra-small -> xs).
  Values come from mat.theme() in material-theme.scss; light/dark is resolved by color-scheme, not by this file.
  Only semantic roles are mapped; Material does not expose its tonal palettes as variables.
  Overlaps tokens.css (surface, on-surface) and tailwindcss-primeui (primary): import one seam, not both.
  Wiring: @import './design/material-tokens.css'; after tailwindcss in styles.css.
*/

/* inline: utilities emit var(--mat-sys-*) directly, so mat.theme-overrides() and scoped themes take effect. */
@theme inline {

@layer components {
  .btn-filled {
    @apply rounded-sm bg-primary px-4 py-2 text-label-lg text-on-primary hover:bg-primary/90 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-primary;
  }

  .btn-outlined {
    @apply rounded-sm border border-primary px-3 py-1 text-label-md text-primary hover:bg-primary-container;
  }

  .btn-text {
    @apply text-label-md text-on-surface-variant underline underline-offset-2 hover:text-on-surface;
  }

  .field {
    @apply w-full rounded-sm border border-outline bg-surface px-3 py-2 text-body-md text-on-surface placeholder:text-on-surface-variant focus:border-primary focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/30;
  }

  .card {
    @apply rounded-md border border-outline-variant bg-surface-container-low p-5 shadow-level1;
  }

  .meta {
    @apply text-label-md text-on-surface-variant;
  }

  .list-item {
    @apply flex w-full items-start justify-between gap-2 rounded-sm px-3 py-2 text-left hover:bg-surface-container-high;
  }

  .list-item-active {
    @apply bg-primary-container text-on-primary-container hover:bg-primary-container;
  }

  .list-item-active .meta {
    @apply text-on-primary-container;
  }

  .badge {
    @apply shrink-0 rounded-xs px-2 py-0.5 text-label-md;
  }

  .task-row {
    @apply flex items-center justify-between rounded-sm border border-outline px-4 py-3;
  }
}

_**Agent (copilot/claude-haiku-5.5)**_

The deals template now uses semantic Material tokens (`bg-surface`, `text-on-surface`, `bg-primary`, `bg-error-container`, `shadow-level1`, and so on) instead of Tailwind palette and size classes. The repeated sets are extracted with `@apply` into `@layer components` in `src/styles.css#L13-L60`: `btn-filled`, `btn-outlined`, `btn-text`, `field`, `card`, `meta`, `list-item`, `list-item-active`, `badge`, and `task-row`. Only the template in `src/app/deals-page/deals-page.ts` changed; the component class has no logic changes. Both files report no errors.

Things that changed beyond a pure color swap, so you can check them:
- Font weights now come from the M3 type roles (`text-title-sm`, `text-label-md`, and so on), so the `font-semibold` and `font-bold` classes are gone and headings render at M3 weights.
- Status badges map to M3 container roles: negotiation and medium use tertiary, new uses secondary, proposal uses surface-variant, and closed-lost and high use error.
- Rounded corners follow the token scale (`rounded-sm`, `rounded-md`, `rounded-xs`).
- Hover states use `primary/90` and the container roles, not state-layer opacities.

I haven't run the app to check the visual result.
